title: Enzymatic Synthesis of High-Density RNA Microarrays
author: Schaudy, Lietard, et al.
materials: RNase-free water (Carl Roth, art. no. T143.5)
RNase AWAY surface decontaminant (ThermoFisher Scientific, cat. no. 7002)
Acetylated BSA (10 mg/ml) (Promega, cat. no. R3961)
Primer oligonucleotide (2′O-methyl RNA with 5′ psoralen-C2 modification)
Triton X-100 (Sigma Aldrich, cat. no. T8787)
DTT (0.1 M) (e.g., ThermoFisher Scientific, cat. no. 707265ML)

Cy3‐UTP (1 mM) (Jena Bioscience, cat. no. NU‐821‐CY3)Microarray scanner, e.g., GenePix 4400A (Molecular Devices) with laser and emission filter for the fluorescent dye used, e.g., emission filter 575DF35 (558 nm to 593 nm) for the green laser to detect Cy3

Fluorescently labeled (e.g., Cyanine3) DNA probe with the sequence identical to the template sequence intended as control (0.1 µM, e.g., from Eurogentec) [For example, the product of conversion of the template 5′‐TCAACCCAGGTCCAATTTCC‐3′ can be detected with the probe 5′‐Cy3‐TCAACCCAGGTCCAATTTCC‐3′)]Microarray scanner, e.g., GenePix 4400A (Molecular Devices) with laser and emission filter for the fluorescent dye used, e.g., emission filter 575DF35 (558 nm to 593 nm) for the green laser to detect Cy3

Fluorescently (e.g., Cyanine3) labeled DNA probe with the sequence identical to the template sequence intended as control (0.1 µM, e.g., from Eurogentec; for example, the product of conversion of the template 5′‐TCAACCCAGGTCCAATTTCC‐3′ can be detected with the probe 5′‐Cy3‐TCAACCCAGGTCCAATTTCC‐3′)Microarray scanner e.g., GenePix 4400A (Molecular Devices) with laser and emission filter for the fluorescent dye used, e.g., emission filter 575DF35 (558 nm to 593 nm) for the green laser to detect Cy3)RNase H (5 U/µl) (NEB, cat. no. M0297) supplemented with RNase H reaction buffer 10×

steps.title: Pre‑incubate surface with BSA
steps.instruction: Incubate the microarray surface with acetylated BSA to equilibrate the surface, remove residual EDTA, and block polymerase adhesion.

steps.title: Prepare Cy3‑UTP mix
steps.instruction: Make a Cy3‑UTP solution at 1 mM using Cy3‑UTP (Jena Bioscience, cat. no. NU‑821‑CY3).

steps.title: Label DNA probe with Cy3
steps.instruction: Add a fluorescently labeled DNA probe (Cyanine3) at 0.1 µM (Eurogentec) whose sequence matches the template (e.g., 5′‑Cy3‑TCAACCCAGGTCCAATTTCC‑3′).

steps.title: Prepare RNase H reaction mix
steps.instruction: Combine RNase H at 5 U µl⁻¹ (NEB, cat. no. M0297) with RNase H reaction buffer at 10× concentration.
